title.narrative: Enhanced EU-GCC political dialogue, cooperation and outreach

description.narrative: This action aims to contribute to a stronger relationship between the EU and the GCC by enhancing the political dialogue, cooperation and outreach between the two sides. It will do so by supporting the GCC countries in their ongoing national transformation processes, facilitating effective implementation and monitoring of the Cooperation Arrangements with the GCC countries, enhancing the understanding and visibility of EU in the region and helping deepen the people to people links.

comment.narrative: No baseline was established for this project at its start in 2020. This indicator will largely be based on the outcomes of the implementation of the activities under the Political Cooperation component of the project and in particular Result 2 Strengthening of the implementation and monitoring of the Cooperation Arrangements

The initial target 1 process per GCC country has been reached. The target has been increased. Strengthening will be evidenced by the follow up activities delivered by the project building on the directionorientations set by the Senior Officials Meetings in the framework of the implementation of the Cooperation Arrangements or Sectoral Dialogues between EU and GCC countries this will be happening at individual partner country level and at regional level

1 The workshop Quality standards and legal and regulatory framework in tourism industry. EU experience sharing with the Ministry of Heritage and Tourism of Oman addressed topics identified among the priority themes of mutual interest for the EU and Oman during the 2019 EUOman Sectoral Dialogue on trade investment and economic policies hosted under the framework of the EUOman Cooperation Arrangement CA contributing to the strengthening of the EUOman CA implementation. 2 The knowledge shared during the workshop series on Practices and procedures for legislative planning policy making and legislative drafting in the Institutions of the EU and its MS implemented on request of and in collaboration of Kuwait Supreme Council of Development and Planning government institution in charge among other responsibilities to participate in policy making propose primary or secondary legislation and submit policy proposals or draft legislation to the Council of Ministers for approval and working to align all institutions driving the agenda of Kuwaits national vision for 2035 contributed to answer questions on how best to structure and enhance quality of policy making and law drafting processes in Kuwait. Workshop contributed to furthering the EUKuwait cooperation in the fields of Good governance Rule of law Statesociety relations including policymaking and representation and EUDELs cooperation with National Assembly. 3 The highlevel event Driving Womens Empowerment Forward. Womens Empowerment Principles WEPs and the Role of Business to Accelerate Equality in the Workplace was held as a follow up to the EUKuwait informal Human Rights Dialogue with a strong focus on womens empowerment. The event was part of the 16 Days of Activism campaign against Gender Based Violence an international campaign that commences on 25 Novemberthe International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Womenand ends on 10 December Human Rights Day.4 High level panel discussion EUBahrain A MultiDimensional Partnership implemented in collaboration with Bahraini think tank Derasat marked the first anniversary of the signing of the Cooperation Arrangement between the European External Action Service and Bahrains Ministry of Foreign Affairs5 During the Regional highlevel Workshop on enhancing EUGCC Judicial cooperation and presentation of a Web Portal facilitating Mutual Legal Assistance participants exchanged perspectives solutions and operational recommendations to enhance EUGCC collaboration in the domain of judicial cooperation and agreed on the number of follow up activities to continue practical cooperation including nomination of the country level focal points to collaborate with EurojustConferences on Freedom of Religion and Believe promoted cooperation and dialogue between the Kingdom of Bahrain and the EU on the topic. The position of the Kingdom of Bahrain as a pioneer on FORB in the GCC is reinforced and made visible towards its GCC partners and the EU. The credibility of the Kingdom of Bahrain in the area of FORB is reinforced also towards the European Parliament. The potential for using FORB as a leverage for both the EU and the Kingdom of Bahrain in improving their collaboration in other areas of Human Rights and beyond is confirmed

1 Media Outreach Programme around EXPO 2020 in Dubai promoting the EU participation at EXPO with 3 videos en English and Arabic those included EXPO umbrella video EXPO EU Climate action video and Women and Career Progression video interviews with the EU Ambassador and panellists of the Women and Career Progression event as well as other promotional material including social media posts booklet press releases. The media outreach programme also accompanied implementation of the EXPO event Widening the Pool Harnessing Womens Talents and Abilities for the Fourth Industrial Revolution in partnership with the French Pavilion 7 Mar 2022 and EXPO event Womens Status in Institutions and Culture Consolidation and Enhancement in partnership with the Italian Pavilion 8 Mar 2022 and included the number of interviews conducted with EU speakers social and traditional media coverage2 Media Outreach Programme in Kuwait ongoing consisted of 5 media appearances of the EUDELs representatives in Kuwaits top media both online and print celebrating international days. The first part of this programme aimed exclusively at digital media in partnership with Kuwaits top Arabic speaking newspapers featuring H.E. Ambassador Tudor in three short video interviews under the banner Coffee with the EU Ambassador to mark three International Day of Peace 21 September 2021 World Tourism Day 27 September 2021 and International Human Rights Day 10 December 2021. The second part of the media outreach program focused on gender issues and softer topics aiming at a mix of online and traditional media featuring Irina Gusacenko Political Officer at the EUDEL to Kuwait and consisted of two written media interviews leveraging a female EU diplomat to demonstrate EU gender equality and women empowerment in action and connect with the womens readers March 2022. The programme continues with Communication and visibility enhancement support to the EUDEL around National and Liberations Days February 2022 Ramadan April 2022 and Europe day celebrations May 20223 Media Outreach programme in Bahrain consisted of 2 media interviews with Ambassador Simonnet published by prominent media outlet in Bahrain AlAyamand shared on their social media and reshared by EUDEL and EU regional Spokesperson in Arabic. First interview highlighted EUBahrain relations aiming to increase understanding of the EU the work it does in Bahrain and the region and touch upon the longstanding collaboration in all policy areas. Second interview promoted the EU as a world class study abroad destination which consisted of a written media interview on the opportunities of Bahraini students to study in Europe and the unique advantages it offers. The project pitched the HoD interview to the Bahraini media in both English and Arabic.4 Study in Europe social media campaign for KSA Oman and Bahrain has been launched The campaign runs on the social media channels of the EUDELs in the region and is amplified as appropriate on the relevant channels of EU Services. The campaign consists of a variety of content formats such as photos factsheets mythbusters did you knows gifs videos and animations. It also includes short socialmedia video testimonial interviews with GCC students who have studied in the EU. The campaign is largely based on existing materials adapted to the GCC context. Posts will be bilingual in EN and AR but the actual materials will only be in English.
